statement: Anthropic is expected to become Broadcom's largest XPU customer in 2027 and OpenAI could deploy more than 5 gigawatts of Broadcom's next-generation Jalapeno XPU in 2028.
why: Concentrating projected growth in a handful of model labs makes the custom-silicon outlook dependent on those labs' funding and deployment schedules.

impact.mechanism: A small set of frontier labs accounts for the bulk of projected XPU volume, so their capacity decisions swing both ASIC demand and merchant GPU share.

evidence.excerpt: Anthropic is expected to become Broadcom's largest XPU customer in 2027, while OpenAI could deploy more than 5 gigawatts of Broadcom's next-generation Jalapeno XPU in 2028.

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet; the statements are expectations about future customers rather than confirmed orders.
